title: Vintage Car by Bus Stop Roadway, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1960s black-and-white snapshot showing an asphalt driveway or bus turnaround area with 'BUS STOP' painted on the pavement. In the foreground, rope or chain barriers hang between small stanchions. A mid-century sedan is visible on the drive, set against curved curbs, vintage multi-globe lampposts, manicured shrubbery, and a tree-lined hillside in the distance under a bright sky.
